automatic/manual tracing parity. Capture nested tools, reported
status/errors, cancellation, truncation flags, and request IDs. Report
cache-inclusive prompt usage without double-counting.

Before:

```text
Cursor Agent [task]
|-- tool: shell [tool]
`-- tool: task [tool]

        (nested tool calls omitted)
```

After:

```text
Cursor Agent [task]
|-- shell [tool]
`-- task [tool]
    `-- Cursor Subagent [task]
        `-- read [tool]
```
